// diagnostic

E2201

`jet dev` can't interpret this program yet — it uses a feature the dev interpreter doesn't cover (a task/channel, `extern rust`/C FFI, an `#Unsafe`/`core.mem` region, or a native-only core module like files/clock/random/environment/process).

What

`jet dev` can't interpret this program yet — it uses a feature the dev interpreter doesn't cover (a task/channel, `extern rust`/C FFI, an `#Unsafe`/`core.mem` region, or a native-only core module like files/clock/random/environment/process).

Why

The dev interpreter runs a deterministic, pure-enough subset for instant feedback; features that touch threads, foreign code, raw memory, or the outside world need the real native build.

Fix

Run `jet build` then the binary, or `jet run <file>` to compile and run it; `jet dev` keeps showing checks live. Opt in with `jet dev <file> --try-anyway` to attempt execution past the boundary, with no guarantees (D-DEV1).
